airline_monthly.label: Airline monthly traffic
airline_monthly.grain: airline x fiscal month x segment (domestic | international)
airline_monthly.description: Scheduled traffic and operating statistics reported by Indian airlines to DGCA (ICAO ATR Form A). Fiscal years run April-March; the latest fiscal year is partial and recent months are provisional. Rows for aggregate entities (ALL SCHEDULED INDIAN AIRLINES, national, private) are totals of airlines and are excluded by default so nothing is double counted.

route_monthly.label: Domestic routes (city pairs)
route_monthly.grain: directed city pair x month (scheduled domestic services)
route_monthly.description: Passengers, freight and mail carried between pairs of Indian places, one row per direction per month, from DGCA's city-pair statistics (2015 onward; freight and mail only from 2018). "Origin" is where the flight departed. Summing both directions by Route gives the pair total. Three months have no data (missing at the source): Jun 2019, May 2021 and May 2024. Place names are harmonised across DGCA's spelling changes; Goa's airports and Mumbai/Navi Mumbai roll up in the "city" dimensions. Not split by airline.

intl_airline_monthly.label: International traffic by carrier
intl_airline_monthly.grain: carrier x month x direction (scheduled international services)
intl_airline_monthly.description: Passengers and freight on scheduled international services to and from India, by carrier (Indian and foreign), month and direction, from DGCA's quarterly international tables (Jan 2015 onward). Excludes Indian carriers' flights entirely outside India (see the city-pair fact, direction "Outside India"). Foreign carriers appear only here, not in the airline statistics.

intl_country_quarterly.label: International traffic by country
intl_country_quarterly.grain: country x quarter x direction (scheduled international services)
intl_country_quarterly.description: Passengers and freight on scheduled international services between India and each country, per quarter and direction (Jan 2015 onward). Quarterly only. The United Arab Emirates figure includes Ajman, Dubai, Fujairah, Ras al-Khaimah and Umm al-Quwain.

intl_citypair_quarterly.label: International routes (city pairs)
intl_citypair_quarterly.grain: directed city pair x quarter x direction (scheduled international services)
intl_citypair_quarterly.description: Passengers and freight between Indian and foreign cities, one row per direction per quarter (Jan 2015 onward), plus Indian carriers' flights between two foreign cities (direction "Outside India"). Summing both directions by Route gives the pair total. Quarterly only; Q1 2026 is missing at the source. Not split by airline.

carrier.label: Carrier
carrier.description: Airline operating scheduled international services (Indian and foreign); names harmonised across 46 quarters.

carrier_origin.label: Carrier type
carrier_origin.description: Indian (domestic) carrier or Foreign carrier, as DGCA classifies them.

direction.label: Direction
direction.description: To India, From India, or Outside India (Indian carriers' flights between two foreign cities).

country.label: Country
country.description: Foreign country at the other end of the flight.

origin.label: Origin
origin.description: Place the passengers departed from (airport/city as published by DGCA; names harmonised).

origin_city.label: Origin city
origin_city.description: Groups airports serving one city (Mumbai + Navi Mumbai; the Goa airports).

route.label: Route (both directions)
route.description: Unordered city pair, e.g. Delhi – Mumbai; sums both directions.
values: Goa (airport not specified) – Ras Al Khaimah

airline.label: Airline
airline.description: Operator name (aliases merged, e.g. 'AIR ASIA excel' -> AirAsia India).

airline_type.label: Entity type
airline_type.description: Airline, or Aggregate for DGCA roll-ups (all scheduled / national / private).

month.label: Month
month.description: Calendar month, ordered April to March.

period.label: Month (timeline)
period.description: First day of the month; use for time series.

route_freight_t.label: Route freight (tonnes)
route_freight_t.description: Published from 2018; earlier months are blank, not zero.

pax_load_factor.label: Passenger load factor
pax_load_factor.description: Passenger-km / available seat-km. Recomputed from sums, never averaged.

known_issues.note: Jet Airways' monthly file for Apr-Dec 2015 is missing at the source (HTTP 403 on DGCA's file store), so airline totals for these months exclude Jet Airways (about 1.3 million passengers a month). City-pair totals are complete.

Q1 2022: the monthly airline statistics report almost no international passengers for March 2022 (e.g. Air India and Air India Express 0) while DGCA's quarterly tables report about 1.5 million for the same Indian airlines, the month scheduled international flights resumed. The two DGCA publications disagree and both are shown as published.
Q4 2022: the monthly airline statistics show 0 international passengers for Air India Express in Nov-Dec 2022; the quarterly tables show about 322,000 per month. The publications disagree.
Q2 2024: IndiGo's May 2024 international passengers are about 190,000 lower in the monthly airline statistics than in the quarterly tables. The publications disagree.

Q3 2019: Air India's international passengers differ by about 10,000 between the monthly airline statistics and the quarterly tables (0.45% of the quarter) beyond what its flights outside India explain. The publications disagree slightly.
Quarterly international files missing at the source: Q1 2025 airline-wise table (the monthly table for that quarter is present) and Q1 2026 city-pair table, so Q1 2026 has no city-pair rows.
Q4 2016 and Q1 2017 carry footnote asterisks on some Air India Express freight figures; the printed totals include them but the country and city-pair breakdowns do not (0.9% of freight in Q4 2016).

DGCA lists a handful of foreign-to-foreign city pairs (e.g. Bucharest-Istanbul, Male-Dhaka, Vancouver-Toronto) in the 'to/from India' block of the city-pair table. They are kept (the printed totals include them) but tagged 'Outside India'.
Published under the city-pair name but contains an airline/country list, not traffic data.
Available tonne-km months sum to 18,312.7 but the sheet's own total says 18,507.6 (1% off). Quarantined rather than guessing which is right.

Goa has two airports since Jan 2023. DGCA published plain 'Goa' for most months, so those figures cannot be split between Dabolim and Mopa; use the Origin city / Destination city 'Goa' to analyse Goa as a whole.
January 2025 lists one 'Hyderabad to HYDERABAD' row (2 passengers). It is kept so the month still reconciles to the sheet total.
City-pair files are missing at the source for May 2021 and May 2024, and the file named 'June 2019' contains an unrelated airline list. Those three months have no route rows.
